description: This file declares the Gem5Manager class, a specialized VM manager for handling gem5-based virtual machines within the Cuttlefish project. It includes method declarations for configuration and startup operations specific to gem5.

classes.name: Gem5Manager
classes.description: A class that manages gem5 virtual machines, inheriting from VmManager, providing methods for support checking, configuration, and startup commands.

methods.name: std::string name()
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this VM manager type, which is 'gem5'.

methods.name: Gem5Manager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Gem5Manager with the specified architecture.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the host environment supports gem5 capabilities.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for the VM based on the provided instance-specific configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot devices for the VM based on the provided instance-specific configuration.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the start commands for the VM, considering dependencies, based on the provided overall config.
